posts.title: Lawn Mowing Tips for Kansas City Yards
posts.excerpt: Cut high, keep blades sharp, and water deep for resilient turf.
posts.body: Healthy turf in KC thrives when cut at 3–4 inches, with sharp blades and deep, infrequent watering. Mulch clippings where possible.

posts.title: Paver Patio vs Concrete: Which is Right for You?
posts.excerpt: Cost, durability, and repairability—see how pavers compare to poured concrete.
posts.body: Pavers cost more upfront but are repairable and allow design flexibility. Concrete is cost-effective for simple pads.

posts.title: Drainage 101: Dry Yards, Happy Homes
posts.excerpt: French drains, downspouts, and grading work together to move water.
posts.body: Combine 4″ perf pipe with fabric wrap, positive slope, and clean outlets for best results.
